info.name: Apifreaks Api Hub For Developers ZIP Code APIs API

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

params.name: code
params.description: The postal/ZIP code to look up. Only one code is accepted per request.

params.name: country
params.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format. Limits results to that country. If not provided, matching locations from all countries are returned.

items.docs: Returns every location worldwide that matches the given postal/ZIP code, optionally narrowed to one country.

info.name: Look up multiple ZIP/postal codes in one request

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

items.docs: Looks up up to 100 ZIP/postal codes in a single request and returns matching location data for each code that resolves.

info.name: Get matching ZIP/postal code pairs within a distance

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

items.docs: Returns every pair of the requested ZIP/postal codes whose distance from each other is at or below the given threshold.

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

items.docs: Calculates the distance from a base ZIP/postal code or coordinate pair to up to 100 comparison postal codes.

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

params.name: city
params.description: Name of the city to find ZIP/postal codes for.

params.name: country
params.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

params.name: state_name
params.description: Name of the state or province associated with the country. Useful to disambiguate cities with the same name in different states.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to retrieve paginated results.

items.docs: Returns every ZIP/postal code associated with the given city and country, optionally narrowed by state or province.

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

params.name: country
params.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

params.name: region
params.description: Name of the region, state, or province associated with the country. Either region or region_code is required.

params.name: region_code
params.description: ISO code of the region, state, or province associated with the country. Either region or region_code is required. region_code takes priority if both are given.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to retrieve. Each page returns up to 500 results.

items.docs: Returns every ZIP/postal code within the given region, state, or province of a country.

info.name: Find ZIP/postal codes within a radius

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

params.name: code
params.description: Postal/ZIP code to use as the center point for the search. Requires country to be set. Alternative to lat/long.

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude coordinate for the center point. Alternative to code/country.

params.name: long
params.description: Longitude coordinate for the center point. Alternative to code/country.

params.name: country
params.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format. Required only when using the code parameter.

params.name: radius
params.description: Search radius for the query. The maximum allowed values are: 100 km, 100 mi, 109361 yd, 100000 m, 328084 ft, 3937007.75 in.

params.name: unit
params.description: Unit for the radius and returned distance values. Supported distance units are m, km, mi, ft, yd, in.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to retrieve. Each page returns up to 500 results.

items.docs: Returns every ZIP/postal code within the given radius of a center point, specified either by code plus country or by latitude/longitude coordinates.
